caveats: Experimental beta for Paseo 0.9.0-beta.1+; 0.9.2 checked offline, 0.12.0-beta.2 live. Block and inline math in completed replies; in the 0.11 web client the latest reply stays native after a page reload.
macOS host and browser components checked; native mobile UI and sustained multi-client load are untested.
Unsupported whole replies stay native; code highlighting and native file interactions are not fully reproduced.
Chat Find cannot search formula source, and before Paseo 0.12 cannot reliably jump into rendered replies; use the Math native-reply Command Center action first.
Unsupported TeX falls back to source. Local MathJax/resvg input bounds are not a hard CPU or memory sandbox.
Avoid enabling another assistant-message replacement plugin for the same content.
